# ciphertrust_aws_iam_users_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve the list of AWS IAM users for a given CipherTrust Manager AWS KMS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all IAM users for a CipherTrust Manager AWS KMS
data "ciphertrust_aws_iam_users_list" "all" {
  kms_id = ciphertrust_aws_kms.kms.id
}

# List the first 25 IAM users whose path starts with /engineering/
data "ciphertrust_aws_iam_users_list" "engineering" {
  kms_id      = ciphertrust_aws_kms.kms.id
  max_items   = 25
  path_prefix = "/engineering/"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kms_id` (String) ID of the CipherTrust Manager AWS KMS whose IAM users are to be listed.

### Optional

- `marker` (String) Pagination marker from a previous response. Use this to retrieve the next page of results.
- `max_items` (Number) Maximum number of IAM users to return. If omitted, all users are returned.
- `path_prefix` (String) Path prefix for filtering IAM users (e.g. /division_abc/).

### Read-Only

- `is_truncated` (Boolean) Whether the results were truncated. If true, use next_marker to retrieve the next page.
- `next_marker` (String) Marker to use in the next request to retrieve the next page of results.
- `users` (Attributes List) List of IAM users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the IAM user.
- `create_date` (String) Date and time the IAM user was created.
- `password_last_used` (String) Date and time the user's password was last used to sign in.
- `path` (String) Path of the IAM user.
- `user_id` (String) Unique ID for the IAM user.
- `user_name` (String) Name of the IAM user.
